muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events sse(Feed(ctx, send))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"time"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Feed multiplexes named events in one stream: the first event carries all
// three option-set wire lines so listeners can select on event name and
// resume from the id; the second carries none, proving options are per-event.
func (Server) Feed(_ context.Context, send func(msg string, opts ...SSEEventOption) error) {
	_ = send("first", WithEvent("news"), WithEventID("42"), WithRetryDuration(3*time.Second))
	_ = send("second")
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	for _, want := range []string{"event: news\n", "id: 42\n", "retry: 3000\n", "data: first\n\n", "data: second\n\n"} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the wire line %q", body, want)
		}
	}
	for _, line := range []string{"event:", "id:", "retry:"} {
		if got := strings.Count(body, line); got != 1 {
			t.Errorf("body = %q has %d %q lines, want 1 (options are per-event)", body, got, line)
		}
	}
}
